class.name: OcgBrepTool
class.brief_description: Provides class methods to access to the geometry of BRep shapes.
class.description: ! Provides class methods to access to the geometry ! of BRep shapes.

method.name: IsClosed_1
method.description: If S is Shell, returns True if it has no free boundaries (edges). If S is Wire, returns True if it has no free ends (vertices). (Internal and External sub-shepes are ignored in these checks) If S is Edge, returns True if its vertices are the same. For other shape types returns S.Closed().

method.name: Surface_2
method.description: Returns the geometric surface of the face. Returns in <L> the location for the surface.

method.name: Surface_1
method.description: Returns the geometric surface of the face. It can be a copy if there is a Location.

method.name: Triangulation
method.description: Returns the triangulation of the face according to the mesh purpose.

method.name: Triangulations
method.description: Returns all triangulations of the face.

method.name: Tolerance_1
method.description: Returns the tolerance of the face.

method.name: NaturalRestriction
method.description: Returns the NaturalRestriction flag of the face.

method.name: IsGeometric_1
method.description: Returns True if <F> has a surface, false otherwise.

method.name: IsGeometric_2
method.description: Returns True if <E> is a 3d curve or a curve on surface.

method.name: Curve_2
method.description: Returns the 3D curve of the edge. May be a Null handle. Returns in <L> the location for the curve. In <First> and <Last> the parameter range.

method.name: Curve_1
method.description: Returns the 3D curve of the edge. May be a Null handle. In <First> and <Last> the parameter range. It can be a copy if there is a Location.

method.name: Polygon3D
method.description: Returns the 3D polygon of the edge. May be a Null handle. Returns in <L> the location for the polygon.

method.name: CurveOnPlane
method.description: For the planar surface builds the 2d curve for the edge by projection of the edge on plane. Returns a NULL handle if the surface is not planar or the projection failed.

method.name: CurveOnSurface_3
method.description: Returns in <C>, <S>, <L> a 2d curve, a surface and a location for the edge <E>. <C> and <S> are null if the edge has no curve on surface. Returns in <First> and <Last> the parameter range.

method.name: CurveOnSurface_4
method.description: Returns in <C>, <S>, <L> the 2d curve, the surface and the location for the edge <E> of rank <Index>. <C> and <S> are null if the index is out of range. Returns in <First> and <Last> the parameter range.

method.name: PolygonOnSurface_1
method.description: Returns the polygon associated to the edge in the parametric space of the face. Returns a NULL handle if this polygon does not exist.

method.name: PolygonOnSurface_2
method.description: Returns the polygon associated to the edge in the parametric space of the surface. Returns a NULL handle if this polygon does not exist.

method.name: PolygonOnSurface_3
method.description: Returns in <C>, <S>, <L> a 2d curve, a surface and a location for the edge <E>. <C> and <S> are null if the edge has no polygon on surface.

method.name: PolygonOnSurface_4
method.description: Returns in <C>, <S>, <L> the 2d curve, the surface and the location for the edge <E> of rank <Index>. <C> and <S> are null if the index is out of range.

method.name: PolygonOnTriangulation_1
method.description: Returns the polygon associated to the edge in the parametric space of the face. Returns a NULL handle if this polygon does not exist.

method.name: PolygonOnTriangulation_2
method.description:
Returns in

, , a polygon on triangulation, a triangulation and a location for the edge .

and are null if the edge has no polygon on triangulation.

method.name: PolygonOnTriangulation_3
method.description:
Returns in

, , a polygon on triangulation, a triangulation and a location for the edge for the range index. and are null if the edge has no polygon on triangulation.

method.name: IsClosed_2
method.description: Returns True if <E> has two PCurves in the parametric space of <F>. i.e. <F> is on a closed surface and <E> is on the closing curve.

method.name: IsClosed_3
method.description: Returns True if <E> has two PCurves in the parametric space of <S>. i.e. <S> is a closed surface and <E> is on the closing curve.

method.name: IsClosed_4
method.description: Returns True if <E> has two arrays of indices in the triangulation <T>.

method.name: Tolerance_2
method.description: Returns the tolerance for <E>.

method.name: SameParameter
method.description: Returns the SameParameter flag for the edge.

method.name: SameRange
method.description: Returns the SameRange flag for the edge.

method.name: Degenerated
method.description: Returns True if the edge is degenerated.

method.name: Range_1
method.description: Gets the range of the 3d curve.

method.name: Range_3
method.description: Gets the range of the edge on the pcurve on the surface.

method.name: Range_2
method.description: Gets the range of the edge on the pcurve on the face.

method.name: UVPoints_2
method.description: Gets the UV locations of the extremities of the edge.

method.name: UVPoints_1
method.description: Gets the UV locations of the extremities of the edge.

method.name: SetUVPoints_2
method.description: Sets the UV locations of the extremities of the edge.

method.name: SetUVPoints_1
method.description: Sets the UV locations of the extremities of the edge.

method.name: HasContinuity_2
method.description: Returns True if the edge is on the surfaces of the two faces.

method.name: Continuity_1
method.description: Returns the continuity.

method.name: HasContinuity_3
method.description: Returns True if the edge is on the surfaces.

method.name: Continuity_2
method.description: Returns the continuity.

method.name: HasContinuity_1
method.description: Returns True if the edge has regularity on some two surfaces

method.name: MaxContinuity
method.description: Returns the max continuity of edge between some surfaces or GeomAbs_C0 if there no such surfaces.

method.name: Pnt
method.description: Returns the 3d point.

method.name: Tolerance_3
method.description: Returns the tolerance.

method.name: Parameter_2
method.description: Finds the parameter of <theV> on <theE>.

method.name: Parameter_1
method.description: Returns the parameter of <V> on <E>. Throws Standard_NoSuchObject if no parameter on edge

method.name: Parameter_3
method.description: Returns the parameters of the vertex on the pcurve of the edge on the face.

method.name: Parameter_4
method.description: Returns the parameters of the vertex on the pcurve of the edge on the surface.

method.name: Parameters
method.description: Returns the parameters of the vertex on the face.
